verdict.rationale: Gmail filters run in the background on incoming mail and can add or remove labels and forward messages. The Gmail API offers push notifications on mailbox changes and programmatic sending, so a developer can build background automations on their own backend server. The Gemini features (organize, draft, summarize) are user-invoked rather than autonomous, so autonomous automation needs either simple rules or self-built infrastructure. Missing for 10: native AI or agentic automations that run unattended, scheduled or trigger-based workflows beyond simple filter actions, a no-code automation builder, and independent hands-on corroboration.
